per_run: verify-record.mjs exits 0 on the output folder (record complete, screenshots real, checker JSON present, before/after evidence present)
one named archetype and two different hero variants are compared and scored before implementation
pre-implementation gate is recorded with block findings resolved or justified
post-render gate is recorded with accepted/rejected findings
screenshots exist at 1440, 768 and 390 pixels and are not blank
one structural rather than cosmetic revision is recorded with before and after evidence
the agent's final reply ends with DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS or BLOCKED, matching the record
across_runs: the named archetype differs across all three briefs
all three conversion actions have honest destinations or local results
no fabricated customers, metrics or endorsements
scoring: Record each assertion as pass, fail, or unverified with a path or command output. Unverified is not a pass. Keep the agent transcript; read it to see where it stopped.
baseline: Run each brief a second time with no skill installed, same model and prompt, and score the same per-run assertions that apply (page renders, checker failures, screenshot of the hero). Compare product fit and how different the three pages look.
